article.title: APD Training Academy Director Investigated for Alleged Domestic Violence
article.author: Joel Elliott
article.content: ATLANTA — The director of the city's police academy is under internal investigation connected to domestic violence allegations from a Barrow County dispute and was temporarily relieved of duty and stripped of his gun and badge.
